- COMPANY & PERIOD: Boeing Company, FY2022
- PRIMARY METRIC: Total Revenue: $66,610 million (per the FY2022 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)

**Revenue Breakdown by Product and Service Category for FY2022:**
1. Commercial Airplanes: $27,068 million (per the FY2022 10-K, Note 2 - Revenue)
2. Defense, Space & Security: $26,197 million (per the FY2022 10-K, Note 2 - Revenue)
3. Global Services: $15,345 million (per the FY2022 10-K, Note 2 - Revenue)

**Analysis of 20% Threshold:**
- Total Revenue for FY2022: $66,610 million
- Categories exceeding 20% of Total Revenue:
  - Commercial Airplanes: $27,068 million (40.7% of Total Revenue)
  - Defense, Space & Security: $26,197 million (39.3% of Total Revenue)

**SUPPORTING DATA: Multi-Period Revenue Breakdown**
- FY2021 Total Revenue: $52,278 million (per the FY2021 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
  - Commercial Airplanes: $14,811 million
  - Defense, Space & Security: $26,153 million
  - Global Services: $13,434 million

- FY2020 Total Revenue: $58,658 million (per the FY2020 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
  - Commercial Airplanes: $39,164 million
  - Defense, Space & Security: $26,965 million
  - Global Services: $15,529 million

**Trends in Revenue Distribution:**
- Commercial Airplanes:
  - FY2022: $27,068 million (40.7%)
  - FY2021: $14,811 million (23.8%)
  - FY2020: $39,164 million (66.8%)

- Defense, Space & Security:
  - FY2022: $26,197 million (39.3%)
  - FY2021: $26,153 million (42.0%)
  - FY2020: $26,965 million (46.0%)

- Global Services:
  - FY2022: $15,345 million (14.4%)
  - FY2021: $21,319 million (34.2%)
  - FY2020: $15,529 million (26.5%)

**DATA SOURCES:**
- FY2022 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations, Note 2 - Revenue
- FY2021 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations, Note 2 - Revenue
- FY2020 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations, Note 2 - Revenue

**Conclusion:**
In FY2022, both the Commercial Airplanes and Defense, Space & Security categories exceeded the 20% revenue threshold, representing 40.7% and 39.3% of total revenue, respectively.
